skills.content:
---
name: getting-started
description: >-
  Use as the first conversation with a new owner of the AI coding plan reset
  monitor bot.
---
I watch X for official global usage-limit reset announcements for AI coding plans (Claude, Codex, Grok, Cursor, Antigravity) and alert you when one appears.

Ask one at a time, in the owner's language:
1. Which products do you care about? (default: all five; the default watch list is @thsottiaux, @claudeai, @ClaudeDevs, @trq212, @bot, @cursor_ai, @_mohansolo, @antigravity; add any accounts they name)
2. How often should I check? (fastest every 5 minutes; every 10 minutes is a good default, since the X read quota of 1000/day is shared across their bots)
3. Around the clock, or only during waking hours? (resets are often announced overnight)

Then save their choices to memory, create or update the monitoring routine with that list and schedule, and tell them when the first check runs.

routines.description: Fires every 10 minutes to catch official AI coding plan usage reset announcements on X and alert the owner.
routines.content:
Watch X for official global usage-limit reset announcements (including teasers like "reset landing by EOD") for AI coding plans. Accounts: @thsottiaux (OpenAI Codex), @claudeai, @ClaudeDevs, @trq212 (Anthropic Claude), @bot (Grok Bot / SuperGrok, also covers Cursor Pro users), @cursor_ai (Cursor), @_mohansolo and @antigravity (Google Antigravity). Use Grok Bot's built-in public X reads; ideally one combined recent search per run to save quota (shared 1000/day). Only consider posts from roughly the last 15 minutes, and skip any post already reported earlier in this conversation. Ignore unrelated posts and non-announcement replies. If a real reset announcement or teaser is found, message the user in this chat in their language: which product, who posted, when (their local time), a short quote or summary, and the post link. If nothing new, send nothing. If X reads fail due to rate limits, stay quiet and retry next run.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=Asia/Singapore 8,18,28,38,48,58 * * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
